title: Building Closeness
heading: Building Closeness
coreClaim: Closeness grows when real common ground and reciprocal self-disclosure build trust at a pace the relationship can safely hold.
distinctMechanism: Similarity opens rapport, but closeness deepens only when disclosure is mutual and calibrated instead of forced.
requiredAnchors: Self-disclosure can increase attraction when it is reciprocal.
Trust weakens when openness outruns the relationship.
specificApplications: Find real similarity in work, school, or personal settings.
commonMisreadings: Telling everything quickly builds trust faster.
Common ground must be major to matter.
Disclosure alone is enough to create closeness.
hardEdgeRequirement: Hard depth must preserve that closeness can weaken when disclosure is not reciprocated or when similarity is exaggerated instead of real.
thresholdQuestion: When does openness deepen trust, and when does it expose imbalance instead?
